title: The Yoke of Babylon

questions.question: Early in the reign of which king did the Lord tell Jeremiah to make himself straps and yoke-bars, and put them on his neck?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:1-2 (ESV): "In the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah the son of Josiah, king of Judah... Thus the Lord said to me: 'Make yourself straps and yoke-bars, and put them on your neck.'" Note: Textual issues sometimes list Jehoiakim here depending on translation/manuscript, but it is directed to envoys coming to Zedekiah in v. 3.

questions.question: Jeremiah was told to send word to several kings via the envoys who had come to Jerusalem. Which of the following is NOT one of those kings?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:3 (ESV): "Send word to the king of Edom, the king of Moab, the king of the sons of Ammon, the king of Tyre, and the king of Sidon by the hand of the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah."

questions.question: The Lord told them: "It is I who by my great power and my outstretched arm have... the earth, with the men and animals that are on the earth, and I give it to whomever it seems right to me."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:5 (ESV): "It is I who by my great power and my outstretched arm have made the earth, with the men and animals that are on the earth,"

questions.question: "Now I have given all these lands into the hand of... , the king of Babylon, my servant, and I have given him also the beasts of the field to serve him."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:6 (ESV): "Now I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, my servant,"

questions.question: What does the Lord say he will do to any nation or kingdom that will NOT put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon?
options: He will punish them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence
He will rain fire upon them
He will send a great flood over their land
He will cause their rivers to turn to blood
questions.correctAnswer: He will punish them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:8 (ESV): "But if any nation or kingdom will not serve this Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, I will punish that nation with the sword, with famine, and with pestilence, declares the Lord,"

questions.question: "So do not listen to your... , your diviners, your dreamers, your fortune-tellers, or your sorcerers, who are saying to you, 'You shall not serve the king of Babylon.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:9 (ESV): "So do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your dreamers, your fortune-tellers, or your sorcerers,"

questions.question: "For it is a... that they are prophesying to you, with the result that you will be removed far from your land, and I will drive you out, and you will perish."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:10 (ESV): "For it is a lie that they are prophesying to you,"

questions.question: What did the Lord declare regarding the nation that brings its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him?
options: I will leave them on their own land... to till it and dwell there
They will be exalted among the nations
They will rule over Babylon eventually
They will be required to pay double tribute forever
questions.correctAnswer: I will leave them on their own land... to till it and dwell there
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:11 (ESV): "But any nation that will bring its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will leave on its own land, to till it and dwell there, declares the Lord."

questions.question: Who did Jeremiah specifically give this same warning to, saying: "Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people and live"?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:12 (ESV): "To Zedekiah king of Judah I spoke in like manner: 'Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people and live.'"

questions.question: What did the false prophets claim would quickly be brought back from Babylon to the Lord's house?
options: The vessels of the Lord's house
questions.correctAnswer: The vessels of the Lord's house
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:16 (ESV): "Then I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, 'Thus says the Lord: Do not listen to the words of your prophets who are prophesying to you, saying, "Behold, the vessels of the Lord's house will now shortly be brought back from Babylon,"'"

questions.question: "Do not listen to them;... the king of Babylon and live. Why should this city become a desolation?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:17 (ESV): "Do not listen to them; serve the king of Babylon and live."

questions.question: "If they are prophets, and if the word of the Lord is with them, then let them... with the Lord of hosts, that the vessels that are left... may not go to Babylon."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:18 (ESV): "then let them intercede with the Lord of hosts, that the vessels that are left... may not go to Babylon."

questions.question: Which of these items is NOT listed among the things left in the city that Nebuchadnezzar did not take away when he exiled Jeconiah?
options: The stands and the rest of the vessels
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:19-20 (ESV): "For thus says the Lord of hosts concerning the pillars, the sea, the stands, and the rest of the vessels that are left in this city, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take..."

questions.question: The Lord declared that the vessels left in the house of the Lord and the king's house would be carried to Babylon and there they shall remain until the day that I... to them. Then I will bring them back...
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:22 (ESV): "They shall be carried to Babylon and remain there until the day that I pay attention to them, declares the Lord. Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place."

questions.question: Under what major symbol did Jeremiah present this message of submission in Chapter 27?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 27:2 (ESV): "Make yourself straps and yoke-bars, and put them on your neck."

key_verse_text: "But any nation that will bring its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will leave on its own land, to till it and dwell there, declares the Lord."
